'''Riklon Tost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Iotran Guard/Legends|Iotran Guard]] on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was one of the few non-Muuns admited to the inner ranks of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC]] officers. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he helped [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] of the InterGalactic Banking Clan to escape from [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tost commanded [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]] in many battles. After the Clone Wars, he served as a liaison between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]], helping the IGBC placate the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] without surrendering any real power. He remained a key advisor to the IGBC executive board all the way to the [[New Jedi Order era]].
